metrics.query: cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'lanternfish-security' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-04-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-04-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.problemTypes[].descriptions[].cweId (placeholders counted: true)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'lanternfish-security' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-04-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-04-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.affected[].cpes[] + containers.cna.cpeApplicability[].nodes[].cpeMatch[].criteria (well-formed CPE 2.3)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'lanternfish-security' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-04-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-04-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions AND has_wellformed_cna_cpe -> cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('lanternfish-security') = [lanternfish]

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'lanternfish-security' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-04-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-04-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> cna.cwe usable AND cna.cpe well-formed AND cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('lanternfish-security')

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'lanternfish-security' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-04-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-04-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions AND (NOT cna.cwe usable OR NOT cna.cpe well-formed) -> containers.adp[] supplies the missing field
